newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Brown says govt off inflation target.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Brown says govt off inflation target.

text.p: British main opposition party Labour's economics spokesman Gordon Brown said the government was failing to meet its inflation target as a result of its economic policies.

A government spokesman said on Thursday that Britain was on course to meet its 2.5 percent inflation target despite figures released earlier showing the underlying annual inflation rate was an unchanged 3.1 percent in January.
But Brown said: "Today's inflation figures show why the Bank of England is convinced that the government will not meet its inflation target by the end of the parliament.
"This failure to meet the Government's own target is another reflection of the underlying problems in the British economy which threaten sustained recovery and lasting prosperity."
